channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Nita Ambani launches The Library at Mumbai’s Nita Mukesh Ambani Cultural Centre with over 4,500 books
item.description: The Library, launched by Nita Ambani at NMACC, aims to encourage reading and bring people together through literature and culture. Designed by Ashiesh Shah, it houses over 4,500 books, including the complete Amar Chitra Katha collection, and will host weekend events.

item.title: India's startup funding slows as global investors turn cautious, capital shifts to US
item.description: Late-stage and angel funding have fallen sharply from their peaks as tighter investment criteria, competition from US AI companies and regulatory changes reshape India's startup financing landscape.

item.title: Tata Agratas sees Chinese partner's board nominee exit ahead of rollout
item.description: The departure of Gordon Louis Chin comes amid a decline in outstanding payments for its services and equipment to AESC and Agratas building its own manufacturing capabilities.

item.title: Maharashtra Charity Commissioner did not propose rule that froze Tata Trusts board
item.description: An RTI response shows the regulator sent no proposal for the amendment that has paralysed Sir Ratan Tata Trust and contributed to a deadlock at Tata Sons.

item.title: This Is Such a Bad Time for a $115 Billion Tech Deal
item.description: Timing is everything when you’re trying to pull off a mega-deal. And it’s hard to think of a worse moment for semiconductor designer Marvell Technology Inc. to unveil a takeover of laser specialist Lumentum Holdings Inc. at a $115 billion enterprise value.

item.title: 'I'm the CEO': Why boss paid ₹2.7 lakh in compensation after employee was unfairly sacked - What really happened?
item.description: Julie Mayes further claimed that Gibbs made sexually inappropriate remarks at the workplace.

item.title: Who is He Yi? How Binance's 7-month-pregnant co-CEO led 100-member war room to tackle $6 bn cyberattack | Full story
item.description: Binance co-CEO He Yi led a 100-member emergency response team after a $6 billion cyberattack on the cryptocurrency exchange. The executive, who is seven months pregnant, coordinated efforts to contain the breach and restore services.

item.title: Flying in Europe to get costlier? Ryanair warns of 20% airfare hike, weighs employee wage freeze
item.description: Ryanair warns ticket prices could surge by up to 20% as fuel hedges expire. The airline is also weighing pay freezes and job cuts to control costs.

item.title: Govt assures liquor makers it will honour scotch import commitments
item.description: Q2 earnings calls show lower import duties beginning to support margins at some companies, even as a DRI review of bulk Scotch imports leaves the extent of the benefit uncertain

item.title: SpaceX's next rival may be AT&T and Verizon as Elon Musk eyes fourth US mobile operator in Boost Mobile deal
item.description: SpaceX is exploring a Boost Mobile deal as Elon Musk targets a fourth US mobile operator to challenge AT&amp;T, Verizon and T-Mobile.

item.title: ITC profit falls 17% as cigarette taxes burns a hole in ITC's profits
item.description: Higher taxes on cigarettes hurt margins and squeezed ITC's consolidated Ebitda, despite robust growth in non-cigarette businesses.

item.title: TVS vs Bajaj Auto vs Ather vs Ola: Who is winning India's electric two-wheeler race? What latest October data reveals
item.description: For now, TVS Motor is the clear winner in the electric two-wheeler race, but Hero MotoCorp's growth and Ather Energy's financial progress suggest that the competition is far from settled.

item.title: Anthropic made $33 billion in 9 months. So why is it reporting a $104 billion loss? What updated IPO filing reveals
item.description: Anthropic posts $104 billion loss as AI infrastructure spending nears $900 billion. The company said it generated $33.24 billion in revenue for the nine months ended September 30, up roughly 1,200% from the same period last year.

item.title: Marico raises growth targets after strong Q2
item.description: Copra prices, Marico's most important raw material cost, fell 31% from a year earlier. However, liquid paraffin and packaging costs remained elevated.

item.title: Deepinder Goyal claims Temple wearable beats Apple Watch Series 12 in heart rate tracking: What we know
item.description: Zomato founder Deepinder Goyal claims his ₹85,000 Temple wearable tracks heart rates more accurately than the Apple Watch Series 12 and other leading devices. A study found lower measurement errors, particularly during high-intensity workouts. Independent researchers are conducting further tests.

item.title: Inside Aditya Birla Group's investment plans in Uttar Pradesh: Here's what Kumar Mangalam Birla said
item.description: Aditya Birla Group Chairman Kumar Mangalam Birla said the conglomerate plans to expand its investments in Uttar Pradesh. At IIT (BHU), he also called for stronger industry-academia partnerships and urged graduates to keep learning and adapt to changing opportunities.

item.title: Who is Padmanabhan Krishnamurthy? The former startup CEO entrusted with Cisco’s legacy code overhaul
item.description: For Krishnamurthy, the assignment marks a significant shift from building AI tools for cross-language communication to taking on a major software modernisation project at one of the world's largest networking and technology companies.

item.title: OpenAI's next big moves? Sam Altman's Samsung meeting, secretive SK Group talks and Abu Dhabi deals
item.description: Sam Altman meets Samsung and SK Group executives in South Korea as OpenAI signs major AI deals in Abu Dhabi amid a fresh $20 billion funding push.

item.title: Marvell to acquire Lumentum in $115 billion all-stock deal, steps up challenge to Broadcom amid AI boom
item.description: The deal is among the biggest corporate acquisitions of 2026 and reflects growing confidence among chipmakers that Big Tech's AI spending boom will sustain demand.

item.title: Sukhjit S Pasricha leaves Jindal Steel: Who is he? Head of Human Resources exits steelmaker – why did he resign?
item.description: Jindal Steel President and Head of Human Resources Sukhjit S. Pasricha has resigned, citing personal commitments. He joined the company in July 2026 after serving at IndiGo and other major organisations.&nbsp;

item.title: Who is Darius Khambata? Harvard alumnus exits Tata Trusts, says September 17 events sullied Tata Sons' reputation
item.description: Senior advocate Darius Khambata will reportedly not seek another term as a trustee of the Sir Dorabji Tata Trust and Sir Ratan Tata Trust. In a letter to Noel Tata and Siddharth Sharma, he also questioned the Tata Sons board’s September 17 decision to retain N Chandrasekaran, as per the report.

item.title: IndiGo CEO William Walsh takes aim at airport monopolies as record fuel costs bite
item.description: Seeking lower taxes and airport fees to protect aviation growth, Walsh warned that rising monopoly tariffs and record jet fuel prices are squeezing airline margins.

item.title: BARC shutdown threat puts 1,500 jobs at risk: Why are TV broadcasters planning layoffs and job cuts? What led to this?
item.description: TV boadcaster-led job cuts are expected to become more visible after Diwali, with networks likely to begin implementing cost-cutting measures.

item.description: Japanese online service company GMO apologizes for security breaches and promises compensation

item.title: Microsoft employee's '0% lifestyle' workday video sparks debate: How different is reality from perk-filled image?
item.description: A Microsoft employee’s work-focused ‘day in my life’ video sparks debate online, contrasting with clips showing office perks. While some welcomed the portrayal, others questioned its authenticity and pointed to his earlier videos highlighting workplace benefits.

item.title: SC rebuke in Vedanta dispute exposes gaps in India’s fast-track arbitration push
item.description: The apex court's sharp criticism of the Centre over a 22-year-old Ravva oilfield dispute highlights how state-led litigation and enforcement delays continue to undermine India's global arbitration ambitions.

item.title: Yuvraj Singh launches supplement brand Protocol 32, TheLiverDoc calls it ‘in very bad faith’, 'business of bad science'
item.description: Hepatologist Dr. Cyriac Abby Philips criticized former cricketer Yuvraj Singh’s new supplement venture, Protocol 32, alleging that its ingredients pose health risks and that many lack strong evidence. Philips also questioned Singh’s collaborators and urged people not to accept invitations to join.

item.description: APPLE-RESULTS/ (PREVIEW, PIX):PREVIEW-Apple's new CEO Ternus to face first earnings test as memory costs surge

item.title: Reliance Foundation to establish Nita Mukesh Ambani Anant Ashray, a 100-acre township for orphans, senior citizens
item.description: Nita Mukesh Ambani Anant Ashray will be developed in phases, subject to approvals, as a not-for-profit township with eight residential villages. The proposed centre will offer housing, healthcare, education and rehabilitation for children, older people and people with disabilities.

item.title: Warren Buffett watched Coca-Cola for 52 years — Why his $1.3 billion bet is still yielding 65% annually
item.description: While the accuracy of the 48-year claim remains unconfirmed, Warren Buffett's affinity for soda is well-documented. In 2019, Buffett, 96, told CNBC that he consumes “probably five 12-ounce Cokes a day.”

item.title: From warehouses to last-mile delivery: How India’s logistics companies are handling festive e-commerce rush
item.description: As festive online shopping gathers pace, India’s logistics companies are expanding warehouse capacity, hiring workers and using AI to manage deliveries. Rising order volumes, bulkier parcels and demand from smaller towns are testing their ability to keep shipments moving and meet delivery promises.

item.title: Binance hack: Crypto exchange resumes withdrawals after more than $6 billion stolen, sees outflow of $4.7 billion
item.description: Binance resumed customer withdrawals after a $6.3 billion cyber theft, reporting a $3.64 billion net outflow on Sunday. The exchange says it will cover the losses and has replenished 90% of the stolen funds. The FBI has attributed the attack to the North Korean hacking group TraderTraitor.

item.title: Flipkart looks to expand FPO tie-ups with focus on value-added, premium produce
item.description: The e-commerce company is investing in local sourcing, demand planning and premium offerings to reduce wastage and strengthen its quick-commerce supply chain.

item.title: Japanese investors deepen India bets, creating a bigger business opportunity for law firms
item.description: Sifting sands of geopolitics has meant that India and Japan come closer. Last year, Japan pledged a target of JPY 10 trillion in private and public investments into India over the next decade. Since Aug 2025, 120 MoUs have been signed targeting over ₹1 trillion of cross border investments

item.title: Air India weighs Singapore Airlines executive for CFO as losses mount
item.description: Air India's management has held preliminary discussions on the appointment with Tata Sons chairman N. Chandrasekaran and Air India chief executive officer (CEO) Tewolde Gebremariam, both of whom are understood to be supportive of the move.
